notes.title: Delay :( !
notes.notes:
Hi folks!

Escape Doodland is completely done and we were supposed to release it really soon but our publisher asked us to give them some more time for promotion and marketing stuff and we agreed. 

Hope you guys won't be mad at us. We know that sucks and sorry for that but we believe that it will bring a lot of benefits.

The final release date is November.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29505993/79f9051de7a753b3a964be134e6bf21f5a0c022c.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Big update and release plans!
notes.notes:
It's been a while since last update.

[h1]Most important thing![/h1]
The game is ready in 98% and the release is scheduled for August (the second half )! Fingers crossed!

[h1]Localization[/h1]
The game has already been translated into German, French, Polish, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian and Simplified Chinese. They are up and running. Spanish is in progress. We are also planning to make Japanese but it's a though one.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29505993/ba8ff31bed320ae73380f457e6e73f38dcdf6a5c.png[/img]

[h1]Steam achievements[/h1]
We've added over 30 achievements and still counting. There will be probably around 40 of them.

[h1]Gamepad support and keyboard[/h1]
That one is very important and a lot of you asked for it. We've added full controller support (both Xbox an PS). It's amazing how much the gameplay has changed. Playing this king of games on a keyboard is a real torture :).
We've also added full in-menu keyboard (and gamepad) navigation so you don't need to use the mouse if don't want to.
image.png
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29505993/ce898bea03d1419679fe40e617c21920e3e1df52.png[/img]

[h1]Levels[/h1]
We've recently change completely 2 levels because we weren't satisfied with them and now all levels are done.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29505993/5f4893c07c2f1be44c79b8af2f91836eddab5d21.png[/img]

[h1]Bug fixing[/h1]
With a professional QA team great help we've found and fixed more than 150 bugs and glitches so the game is even more polished.

[h1]Multiplayer (that one is sad)[/h1]
Unfortunately we have to postpone multiplayer mode :(. 
The plan was to made it with other company's help. It turned out that creating it is much more complicated that they (and we) thought, would cost a lot more and we cannot afford it now. We've tried to make it on our own but Escape Doodland is our first game and our skills are not good enough yet. However, it's not a very bad news because the game will be cheaper :).

Cheers!

notes.title: Escape Doodland looks like a lo-fi Rayman Legends
notes.notes:
Escape Doodland, you may have gathered, is a game about escaping Doodland. More specifically, it's a co-op 2D auto-runner with art straight out of the notebook of a bored art student with too much paper on hand. It's also on Kickstarter, with developer appSide Down asking for $7,838 to bring it to life. At the time of writing, its campaign has raised $1,989 and will run for another 26 days. 

The best doodles are simple, silly ideas taken way too far, and Escape Doodland nails that bonkers look. Everyone has too many eyes and also precisely enough eyes, environments are Alice in Wonderland-esque oddities, and you can often literally see the graph paper in the background. It works because it's everywhere, and there's a surprising amount of detail to it. The devs said they "wanted to combine absurdity with diversity," and only settled on doodles after trying more traditional art styles. 

The game's 10 playable Doodlers all show the same weirdness, from the irresponsibly happy potato to the good old-fashioned blobs. You can play Escape Doodland with up to four people at once, so it's important to have varied characters. You don't want to lose track of yourself, for one, and you're escaping Doodland in the first place because a big red monster is gobbling it up, so you're going to want to know who invariably throws you to the monster in co-op. 

The devs say the bulk of Escape Doodland is finished, and that the Kickstarter money will mainly be used to cover multiplayer and music costs. Depending on the success of its campaign, it will release in mid- to late-2018.
